messages:
Aisha Kaur: Quick heads-up — proposing a phased rollforward for Partner SDK (v3 -> v4) to avoid partner breakage. Plan: 1) feature-flag opt-in; 2) telemetry + compat gate; 3) hard removal window. Want partner comms + marketplace banner. Thoughts? :eyes:
Matt Chen: timeline? can we align with marketplace release window in May?
Aisha Kaur: Targeting GA Apr 15 for v4. Opt-in flag immediate, telemetry gate starts Apr 15, removal Oct 15. That's ~6 months.
Diego Ramos: sounds reasonable. For hardware partners we need a canary build that runs both runtimes. Can we support dual runtime for ~12 weeks?
Aisha Kaur: yes — runtime team ok with dual-mode for 12 weeks. We'll publish a compatibility matrix. @Lara Singh can you own partner docs?
Lara Singh: I can. I'll draft partner-facing note + upgrade checklist. Will need a sample code snippet and CLI flags.
Evan Miller: also add marketplace SKU migration notes. Some partners rely on SKU id; we should support SKU aliasing for at least 6 months.
Matt Chen: recommend adding SDK env var `REDWOOD_SDK_COMPAT=3` and a deprecation header so integrators can detect: `X-Redwood-SDK-Deprecated: v3`.
Aisha Kaur: good call. Example headers for partner responses:
```http
X-Redwood-SDK-Compat: v3
X-Redwood-SDK-Dep-ETA: 2025-10-15
```
Diego Ramos: will ask HW teams to validate memory/latency for v4 quantized builds. ETA 2 weeks.
PartnerBot: Scheduled: partner-notice-send 2025-03-20 09:00 UTC (reminder: 3 business days prior). Draft saved in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c
Lara Singh: I'll sync on comms draft by EOD Wed. @Aisha Kaur can you confirm legal + compliance review window?
Aisha Kaur: Legal review requested, expect signoff within 5 business days. Also scheduling a 30m partner sync Tues 2025-03-25 16:00 PT — invite sent. :calendar:
Evan Miller: noted. I'll prepare marketplace migration playbook and SKU alias mapping.
Matt Chen: can someone add a short snippet for integrators on feature-flag toggling? I'll paste it into the partner doc.
Lara Singh: will do. Action items: Lara -> partner docs & comms, Diego -> HW validation, Evan -> SKU aliasing & marketplace playbook, Matt -> snippet, Legal -> review. We'll follow up after the partner sync. :thumbsup:
